evidence.observation: Version 5 preserves one governing architecture: records.ts remains canonical for citational claims, the Markdown Wiki supplies governed context and navigation, lifecycle records preserve operational provenance, and portfolio, lifecycle, Wiki, hiring, blind-spot, and composite suites retain distinct responsibilities. Required canonical files exist and forbidden parallel registries and public evidence-browser routes are absent.

The system captures stable intake, source, claim, inquiry, project, projection, correction, and lifecycle identities. Maturity, publication safety, and editorial selection remain separate fields; deferred and closed intake require reasons, and non-public intake requires opaque protected locators.

Sources retain independent authorship, organization, kind, visibility, preservation, review depth, support, non-support, rights, consent, and display boundaries. Evidence relationships distinguish direct support, corroboration, context, boundary support, contradiction, and private support, preventing heterogeneous records from becoming undifferentiated proof.

The focused suite passed all ten tests. Fifteen semantic mutations reject attribution loss, sole-credit inflation, endorsement inflation, population and impact inflation, evidence-role substitution, stage inflation, memory promotion, negative-finding absolutism, protected projection, non-support inversion, anti-claim conflict, and stale bindings; packet tests additionally reject unassigned, overlapping, oversized, and uncommitted review surfaces.

Lifecycle commands support validated preview-before-write recording and redacted queries. The composite runner directly calls validateAppendOnlyGitHistory, which executes git log and git show over every committed version and compares each historical snapshot as an exact prefix of the current JSONL. The exact-candidate run passed with two valid append-only events.

Publication is not inferred from maturity: projections have independent statuses and bounded surfaces, while protected and held evidence remains research infrastructure. No evidence-dump route or internal evaluation narration was introduced. Fresh application judgments support a composed portfolio while continuing to flag dense source-led cases and deferred visual evidence.

Jamie remains visible as a specific actor, operating work is translated for hiring readers, and collective work is not converted into sole authorship. The fresh Chad judgment remains appropriately scored at 3 because citation-heavy cases and repeated qualifications still increase scanning effort.

The portfolio sustains a credible connection among participation, hospitality, place, experimental media, material practice, and present systems work. The throughline is still predominantly prose-led because rights-reviewed visual specimens remain blocked, supporting a restrained score of 3.

The architecture makes translations among people, institutions, records, claims, workflows, interfaces, and public action inspectable. The recursive method is credible across cases but is more often described than demonstrated through rights-cleared public artifacts, warranting 3 rather than 4.

Atomic role claims, attribution requirements, collaborator context, anti-claims, evidence boundaries, and the collective-to-sole-credit mutation preserve collective authorship. Unallocated labor remains unresolved rather than being silently credited to Jamie.

Non-public sources cannot expose underlying URLs, protected material requires opaque locators, public query output removes protected locator data, and private filesystem paths are rejected from integration evidence. Citation, knowledge-bank, public-safety, and route checks all passed for the exact candidate.

Stable IDs, explicit statuses, bounded queries, compact fixtures, and a single disposition ledger reduce archival review burden. Public cases remain navigable, but dense histories, numerous citations, and necessary boundary language keep the experience from an exceptional one-pass score.

Version 5 preserves the original ceilings through three exact-accounting packets rather than raising them. The committed candidate contains 104 bound files: 43 portfolio-and-Wiki files, 30 evaluation files, and 31 tooling-and-governance files. The aggregate adds 9,390 lines, the largest file adds 917, every file is assigned once, and no candidate-affecting working-tree path is dirty.

The contract history preserves versions 1 through 4, while version 5 adds bounded review packets and includes Wiki and hiring suites in the no-regression boundary. Every frozen A-through-N source has an exact SHA and capability-level disposition, and deterministic, model, human-reader, rights, production, and approval evidence remain non-substitutable.

The Knowledge Wiki is an authoring and navigation layer over the canonical records.ts architecture, not a competing public registry. Thirty-eight governed Markdown records add typed relations, aliases, backlinks, health diagnostics, wanted-page governance, current opportunity context, and deterministic reports while retaining existing proof, citation, lifecycle, and publication controls. No public Wiki route was added.

Six official current opportunities are decomposed into 34 stable requirements with hard screens, evidence routes, unresolved gaps, freshness dates, and one-year acceptance conditions. Nine reader profiles are explicitly simulated, title-blind discovery outperforms three unrelated negative controls, and the public-only hiring judgment remains separated from later Wiki gap resolution.

The repository reproduced candidate sha256:7004a72cf29879277188328bb70ddc5a2e717e4e8124faa733fce408f9f20c66 and contract sha256:799b20f7ea03bf5e20a17c9f300d7bd700c41d61f63c65482c05fd9dcc11d332 exactly. Focused tests, semantic gates, committed-file accounting, bounded packets, source boundaries, and the application, lifecycle, Wiki, and hiring candidate bindings all passed before this judgment.

The authenticated shared-folder pass accounts for 2,192 reachable descendants while keeping inventory, content review, rights review, claim linking, and projection selection separate. Eighteen selected documents mature into eight bounded sources, seven claims, and three inquiries without presenting the remaining population as close-read evidence.

The archive strengthens collective event operations, participation design, recommendation continuity, and campaign implementation while refusing to infer authorship from Drive metadata or task initials. The present source encounter directly attributes one narrow FOIL and reporting-legislation suggestion to Jamie; the wider collaborative MARCH design remains an attribution and implementation inquiry.

The new method distinguishes located, readable, native, exported, and inaccessible source states; the wanted-page index preserves created, deferred, protected, and rights-blocked dispositions; and each substantive new page carries dated source relations and explicit non-support.

Four new hard gates and four human retrieval tasks make periodic return to original material, librarian handoff, missing-page governance, and non-promotion of unresolved inquiries repeatable across future agent passes.

limitations: This archival-editorial judgment is one of two reviews required for the exact Knowledge Wiki candidate; it does not certify its companion systems review.
The Knowledge Wiki covers a deliberately bounded 38-record governed corpus rather than the full knowledge archive.
The six opportunity records are time-sensitive and require re-verification on their recorded dates; automated fit evaluation does not submit or authorize an application.
Named reader profiles are simulated lenses only and do not establish participation, endorsement, opinion, or a hiring decision by those people.

Human-reader validation, rights review, production deployment and smoke evidence, and Jamie's exact-production-candidate approval remain explicitly blocked. This judgment does not substitute for or close those gates.
Rights-cleared visual evidence remains deferred, limiting Morse and Sack demonstration and preventing a production-readiness claim.
The knowledge-bank check passed with ten warnings; they did not fail the canonical gate but remain review debt.
Prior composite judgments and certification target superseded fingerprints and provide historical context only; they receive no exact-candidate binding credit.
